summary: The prepared base contains the earlier partial fix: a complete text_config rope override passes, but a partial rope_theta override discards the existing rope_type. At exact candidate commit 232bc80929e268025dc5a34f8f0f9b414bbfe78b, the candidate regression suite and independent multi-level text-only and multimodal cases pass. The recursive merge implementation fully resolves the original CPU-side configuration merge contract. The candidate's claim that git diff --check passes is inaccurate because committed raw logs contain trailing whitespace; this does not affect the functional verdict.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the approved remaining counterexample on the recorded base: overriding rope_theta alone discarded rope_type and raised KeyError.
Confirmed the prepared base already handles a complete issue-shaped nested rope override, classifying it as a partial rather than absent fix.
The candidate's complete focused suite passed: 6 tests and 2 processor subtests.

Independent real local-config cases covered recursive sibling preservation across PretrainedConfig and dictionary nodes, text-only and multimodal configs, scalar/list replacement, and a newly introduced dictionary.
Changed Python source and tests compile successfully.
Contrary to the candidate report, committed raw evidence files contain trailing whitespace; no changed functional Python source was implicated.

gpu_execution.evidence: Configuration loading and merging are CPU-only. The visible device was AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), but no GPU kernel was executed.

remaining_limitations: The reported CUDA 13/NVFP4 and two-RTX-5090 TP=2 serving environment cannot be reproduced on the assigned single AMD gfx950 GPU.
Full server startup, model loading, NVFP4 execution, distributed behavior, and semantic accuracy remain unverified.
No native source changed and repository-environment.json declares no native artifact, so no native rebuild was applicable.
